_comment: Generated from cleaned monthly expense history; each limit is the category median rounded up to 500 dataset units. See budgetwise/analysis/budgets/supplementary/budget_justification.md.

unbudgeted_categories: Report categories with spending and no configured limit as unbudgeted.
